title: The Genome Workbench's engine and genomes
about: The genomics and evolution domains' C++ with morphe and calx, compiled once with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL, -O3 -march=native) into data/cache/engines/genome/, about two minutes; and fourteen reference genomes from NCBI RefSeq (12 MB): two phages, SARS-CoV-2, Escherichia coli K-12 and ten primate mitochondria; and for the abnormal genomes and expression of ADR 0064, the human ideogram, a few human genes and chromosomes 21 and 22 of GRCh38, and Escherichia coli's measured abundances and start sites, yeast promoters and their motifs.

steps.title: The engine, compiled with g++ for this processor
Fourteen reference genomes from NCBI RefSeq
The human ideogram of GRCh38 and GRCh37 at 400, 550 and 850 bands, from NCBI's Genome Decoration Page and UCSC
Human RefSeq transcripts and gene regions (HBB, CFTR, BRCA1) for describing variants by HGVS
Human chromosomes 21 and 22 of GRCh38 (99 MB), the references of simulated rearrangements
Escherichia coli's measured protein abundances (PaxDb 6.0, CC BY 4.0)
Escherichia coli's transcription start sites by Cappable-seq (Ettwiller et al. 2016, CC BY 4.0)
Yeast promoters with measured expression, from the DREAM Challenge (Rafi et al., CC BY 4.0)
